label: Beverage
desc: There are some things it's wiser to drink in the morning... and others it's wiser to drink in the evening.

label: Carcass
desc: Something that once moved without my assistance. [Take this to a Necropsy Table to render it into Animal Bones.]

label: First Course
desc: Generally eaten as a light snack, or before a Main Course.

label: Main Course
desc: The heart and mainstay of a good meal.

label: Side Dish
desc: Generally eaten as a light snack, or alongside a Main Course.

label: Pudding
desc: 'If you don't eat yer meat, you can't have any pudding. How can you have any pudding if you don't eat yer meat?' - Waters

label: Ductile
desc: [Take this to a Workbench to render it into Wire.]

label: Instrument
desc: Music waits here.

label: Beast
desc: When it moves, and it's not the wind, and it's not a person.

label: Egg
desc: 'When an egg is not dead, something may emerge. When an egg is dead, something may be placed within.' - Thirza Blake, seventh Librarian of Hush House

label: Fabric and Fibre
desc: Killasimi, the 'woven language', is written with thread, not ink. There are of course other, more prosaic uses for fibre too. Upholstery can be more adventurous than it sounds.

label: Flower
desc: The hair of a plant.

label: Bread
desc: The grains suffer so, that they may enter into us and be one with us.

label: Candle
desc: They generally burn brighter, but we generally burn longer.

label: Device
desc: A machine that will only operate once. If it's an infernal device, that means it'll explode, so be careful.

label: Fruit
desc: The womb of a plant?

label: Fuel
desc: 'Each hour has its colour. Each flame has its fuel. Don't trust your dreams.' - George Collers, first and last Governor of Brancrug Gaol

label: Gem
desc: Sometimes shiny; always precious.

label: Glass
desc: Lucent and fragile. Even sand may some day be the eye of rock.

label: Cooking Ingredient
desc: This will be part of something greater. [When you have HOUSE OF LIGHT, Cooking Ingredients can be used for cooking and making food in the kitchen.]

label: Inert
desc: A device; but not one that can be activated by casual handling. [This can survive Consider without being used up, although it'll still be used up in crafting.]

label: Ink
desc: If it scrawls, mix it.

label: Intoxicating
desc: 'Quick, bring me a beaker of wine, so that I may wet my mind and say something clever.' - Aristophanes

label: Kitchenware
desc: This won't look wildly out of place beside a saucepan.

label: Knife
desc: 'This is the line of division.' - Wolfe

label: Leaf
desc: The hands of a plant.

label: Lesson
desc: One step on Wisdom's staircase. [Use this to gain or improve a Skill.]

label: Liquid
desc: 'What seeks the depths, flees the heights, and cannot be constrained by any chain ever forged?'

label: Lens
desc: Thomas Dewulf, called Baron Silence, built the observatory at Brancrug. He was known to pay well, but his requirements were so exacting that no lensgrinder would work with him twice.

label: Light
desc: So we can see, or so we can celebrate.

label: Mark
desc: A fragile, unstable trace.

label: Material
desc: Something with the potential to become something. If I put it in something.

label: Memory
desc: Something remembered might be something understood. [Memories can be used to help with crafting and to upgrade Skills. Memories disappear each dawn - except Persistent ones.]

label: Metal
desc: This is what happens when stone gets serious.

label: Numen
desc: Write a truth in a book that no-one reads. Then drop dead. No-one knows what you wrote. Unless the truth is numen. [Numina are truths so powerful that they, tentatively, believe themselves. You can use a Numen to write a new History at a suitable Desk... if you can assemble 25 of a matching Aspect.]

label: Omen
desc: Those who know, see; those who see, know.

label: Persistent
desc: Persistent Memories survive the dawn, but when the season called Numa passes, they will depart with it. Numa comes to Brancrug in one season out of every nine - but exactly when is never certain, and years may pass without any sign of Numa's mists.

label: Pigment
desc: Call it a colour, call it a stain, call it a jewel-in-waiting.

label: Raw
desc: This might be edible, but you wouldn't serve it on a plate to a guest.

label: Remains
desc: This is how you know who was mortal.

label: Restorative
desc: For rest and recovery. [Something that will help you recover from Maladies if you use it in bed with sufficient suitable Power aspects - especially, but not exclusively, if it has useful Power aspects itself.]

label: Root
desc: The feet of a plant.

label: Seed
desc: A seed may grow worse in one garden than another, and better in one season than another.

label: Sound
desc: Before silence, and after.

label: Stone
desc: 'Ye who seek patience, here is your tutor.'

label: Sustenance
desc: 'The bad live that they may eat and drink; the good eat and drink that they may live.' - Socrates

label: Thing
desc: 'The gentleman makes things his servants. The petty man is servant to things.' - Master Xun

label: Tool
desc: One reason the apes beat the beetles.

label: Wrapping
desc: Turns an order form back into a delivery

label: Wood
desc: The pillars of the sky, to some; to others, paper in waiting.

label: Made of Wood
desc: [Take this to a Workbench to render it into Wooden Scraps.]

label: Woven
desc: [Take this to a Workbench to render it into Rags.]
